newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy market sees rates down in a month.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy market sees rates down in a month.

text.p: Italian money markets continue to expect a 50 basis point fall in interest rates in the course of a month, a study by the Igier research arm of the Bocconi University showed.
In the study based on implicit forward rates, the implicit overnight rate was seen at 7.50 percent one month from now, the same level as the official discount rate currently.
This compares with an actual overnight rate of 7.94 percent registered on Thursday, the day on which Igier based its study, and to a 7.44 implicit rate a week ago.
On a three month horizon, the implicit overnight rate was projected at 6.84 percent against expectations for 6.72 percent last week.

Expectations for the overnight rate's movement over a 12 month period remain relatively steady with this week's implicit overnight rate for one year hence at 5.91 percent against 6.01 percent last week and 6.02 percent a month ago.

The spread between the implicit Italian overnight rate two years hence and the same German rate, which is considered a good indicator of confidence in European monetary union, fell to 191 basis points from 206 seven days ago and 207 a month ago.
